$comment: MB-31, copied from the stage 2 draft: scripts/seeds/bylaw/building-types.json (queue (b); LC-16). Increment 1: one row. A type with no Phase 2 class answers not_modelled (R3-11, M-393). Increment 3 (MB-27, DL-21): the detached_houseplex row joins (units 4, M-160 / Q6 a) at element `"3"`. Increment 4 (MB-27, Spec 69a M-379 / M-344 dated notes 2026-11-11): the house_with_secondary_suite row joins (units 2, vocab scenario_class_units, P-4) at element `"4"`; its `base_type` names the row its LC-33 gain is taken over (D-2 a). `units_floor` (E7) is the unit count a type needs from the stored dwelling_units_max cap: below it the units_max revision of increment 4 refuses (units_differ_from_phase2) instead of showing a smaller count; the detached house needs 1, the suite house 2; the houseplex is held at 1 so its increment-3 values do not move (its own cap-1 question is the side finding of card CARD-E7-UCAP, not ruled).

units_floor_census.$comment: E7 (Spec 69a M-344 dated note 2026-11-11; card CARD-E7-UCAP lock item 2, OUTPUT panel fold): the step counts the rows the units_max increment-4 revision refuses, records_meta units_floor_refusals, so a night shows how many lots hold a dwelling-unit cap below a type's units_floor.

gain.$comment: D-2 a (MB-27 increment 4, operator 2026-11-11; Spec 69a M-379 dated note 2026-11-11; LC-33; Spec 78 P5.2 item 11, P5.10): the LC-33 gain of a type that names a `base_type`, computed by one generic comparison after the step's per-type loop. `fields`: each gain field is the type's catalogue row minus the base type's row of the same id (headline vs headline, same roof-form basis), NULL (not_evaluated, the non-computed row's reason propagating unchanged, or its status word) when either row is not computed or either type is not permitted. `reasons`: keyed by the releasing clause; a Phase 2 principal cell of the type that differs from the base type's is looked up by the clause (the winner unit) it carries; a mapped clause names its reason only if swapping that one cell into the base type's run changes a compared row (the "actually bound" test); any differing cell whose clause is not listed, and any differing roof-option cell, fails closed: the reasons row is not_evaluated with reason `fail_reason` (M-379 invariant, MB-64). The reasons row carries its closed words in `flags` (the text[] of P5.10), sorted, `none_word` when no reason binds.
